name: Goblins

variantInfo.name: Goblin
notes: The common level-2 Goblin has 5 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush) and gives 5 Slayer XP; it is the easiest variant to kill for a quick task.
Higher Goblin variants (level 5 use a 6-tick attack and give 12 XP; level 13 give 16 XP), Cave goblins, Cave goblin guards, and the Bandos room Sergeants (Strongstack/Grimspike/Steelwill) also count.

locationComparison.name: Goblin spawns (various)
notes: Goblins are very common across Lumbridge and Goblin Village; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Goblins are a fast, trivial starter Slayer-XP task.

taskNotes: Goblins are assigned by Turael and Spria (Spria after completing A Porcine of Interest); there is no combat, Slayer, or quest requirement to be assigned.
slayerTargetId 291 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The common level-2 Goblin has 5 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 1 (all defence bonuses -15).
Goblins have no elemental weakness; any melee weapon clears them.
Many variants count and benefit from the Slayer helmet/black mask: level 5/13 Goblins, Cave goblins and guards, and the Bandos room Sergeants (Strongstack, Grimspike, Steelwill).
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Goblins.
recommendedMethod: A fast, trivial low-level Slayer-XP task: kill the common level-2 Goblins near Lumbridge or at Goblin Village with any melee weapon. Goblins have negligible Defence and a max hit of 1, so no food or special gear is needed; the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak.
